name: announce
title: Announce
description: Says a message to screen-reader users through one shared live region, politely or at once, without moving focus.

meta.when: Something changed that a sighted person can see but no focus change will read out: an item was moved, a filter applied, a total changed, a reply finished. Not for content the person is about to read anyway, and not for errors on a field (use the field's own message). A component that is already a live region (status-line, toaster) does not need it.
meta.example:
announce("Lunch moved to position 2 of 5");
announce("The connection was lost", "assertive");
